legacy_preserves: All relative paths, file modes and blobs. The legacy tree is not used by CMake.

forms.Inline: Imported implementations; selected by the API by default.
forms.Template: Shared traits-based source; built only when AWE_BUILD_TEMPLATE is enabled.

historical_records: Earlier source-tree hashes and library digests retain their original meaning. Updated path fields locate the corresponding files in the current layout. They do not claim that renamed files have an earlier file digest.
